prompt_md: Walking up the stairs from floor 1 to floor 3 takes you 20 seconds. At the same pace, how many seconds does it take to walk from floor 1 to floor 9?
prompt_short: Floor 1 to 3 takes 20 s. How long from floor 1 to floor 9?
hint_md: Count flights of stairs, not floors.
explain_intuition_md: Floor 1 to floor 3 is only 2 flights, so each flight takes 10 seconds. Floor 1 to floor 9 is 8 flights. Tripling the 20 seconds counts floors instead of flights.
